According to the document [1], the total initial mass in space for the 2033 crew flight is 127t, and the mass of the transit habitat is 36.6t. To find the mass of the transit habitat itself, we need to subtract the mass of the habitat from the total initial mass in space.

Mass of transit habitat = 36.6t
Total initial mass in space = 127t

Mass of other components = Total initial mass in space - Mass of transit habitat
= 127t - 36.6t
= 90.4t

Therefore, 90.4t of the total initial mass in space is not the transit habitat itself.
